tasks.title: Prepare and check the source data
tasks.done_when: Source and preparation manifests plus passing verification report.

tasks.title: Prepare the notebook and readable guide
tasks.done_when: Notebook executes and guide links work.

tasks.title: Discuss the shopper problem and first-version scope
tasks.done_when: Record a clear problem hypothesis, assumptions, scope and acceptance criteria in the product brief.

tasks.title: Explain an order and a product line
tasks.done_when: Explain the first notebook example in plain language and save the lesson note.

tasks.title: Explain repeat shares and evaluation cutoffs
tasks.done_when: Explain the denominator, unknown test contents and why later baskets stay out of inputs.

tasks.title: Review discovery questions and record evidence
tasks.done_when: Record real evidence if available; otherwise keep user needs explicitly unvalidated. No invented interviews.

tasks.title: Explore repeat purchases and write observations
tasks.done_when: Save checked observations with counts, denominators and limitations, after discussion.

tasks.title: Build a popularity baseline
tasks.done_when: Deterministic valid top-five lists, using only eligible earlier history; save checks.

tasks.title: Build a personal-history recommender
tasks.done_when: Specify frequency/recency rules, fallback behaviour and traceable explanations; compare on validation.

tasks.title: Agree success criteria before final evaluation
tasks.done_when: Record primary/supporting metrics, meaningful improvement threshold, uncertainty and trade-offs before final scores.

tasks.title: Build and validate a machine-learning challenger
tasks.done_when: Features obey the earlier cutoff; compare relevance, coverage and complexity; lock the method.

tasks.title: Run the fixed methods on final target baskets
tasks.done_when: Matching users/targets, paired comparison and segment results; no tuning against final answers.

tasks.title: Build the Streamlit demo and performance view
tasks.done_when: User selection, unique valid suggestions, honest explanations, error handling and readable evaluation.

tasks.title: Observe a prototype walkthrough and improve it
tasks.done_when: Save observed usability issues, changes and limits; distinguish reviewer feedback from shopper validation.

tasks.title: Choose the approach and propose a real app test
tasks.done_when: Record evidence, alternatives, complexity trade-offs and a proposed experiment without claiming business impact.

tasks.title: Finish the case study and demonstration
tasks.done_when: Reproducible setup, clear walkthrough, accurate personal contribution and evidence-based résumé bullet.

tasks.title: Consider a separate Power BI report
tasks.done_when: Only add it if a target role needs it and it adds a useful view beyond the app.
